cross_run_summary.note: The 6 per-period runs are cold-start slices (independent primary evidence). The global run is a continuous sanity run: its extra orders come from uninterrupted indicator state, not from independent sampling.

findings.defect_assessment: No trading-logic defect found. The creation-time RR gate, the next-bar-open fill timing, the inverted-fill refusal and the expiry/invalidation lifecycle all behave as designed. The observed incompatibility is between the configured BREAKOUT_CONTINUATION entry model and the 1:6 realized-RR floor, not a software bug.
findings.observability_gap: The Phase-18 artifact persisted terminal counts only (rr_rejections=None, no rejection reasons), so the cause was not recoverable from persisted evidence. The opt-in order_trace sink repairs this without altering semantics.
findings.strategy_version_assessment: Behavioral: the certified funnel is reproduced exactly. Byte-level: the historical strategy pin does not match current bytes and the certified commit is not an ancestor of HEAD; the certified harness is absent at that commit.
findings.zero_fill_root_cause: Every order that triggered reached its single next-bar-open fill attempt; none was filled. The dominant cause is the frozen-era realized-RR floor: the breakout-continuation entry fills AFTER price has already moved beyond the order's entry level, so the executable reward:risk at the next open is far below the 1:6 creation-time geometry. A further two fill attempts were refused by the shared directional-geometry gate because the next open was already BEYOND the take-profit (the frozen log verb ORDER_SKIPPED_INVERTED_FILL names the gate, not a stop gap); zero attempts gapped through the stop.
